mapper.select: SELECT U.userseq , U.userid , U.name , U.nickname , U.summary , U.profile_orgfilename , NVL(U.profile_sysfilename, 'default.png') AS profile_sysfilename , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_recipe R WHERE R.fk_userseq = U.userseq) AS recipe_count , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SR.fk_recipeseq || '-' || SF.fk_userseq) FROM tbl_recipe R JOIN tbl_scrap_recipe SR ON R.recipeseq = SR.fk_recipeseq JOIN tbl_scrap_folder SF ON SR.fk_folderseq = SF.folderseq WHERE R.fk_userseq = U.userseq AND SF.fk_userseq != U.userseq) AS total_scrap_count FROM tbl_user U JOIN tbl_authorities A ON U.userseq = A.fk_userseq WHERE A.authority = 'ROLE_CHEF' ORDER BY total_scrap_count DESC, recipe_count DESC, U.userseq ASC
